verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents AWS's own IaC tools (CloudFormation templates and the CDK), the CLI, and MCP servers. Nothing mentions an official, vendor-maintained Terraform or OpenTofu provider, its release cadence, or its service coverage. CloudFormation and CDK are adjacent IaC features and earn no credit for a Terraform-provider story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the official Terraform/OpenTofu provider is real — vendor-maintained, actively released, covering the core services I run
